name: Programmatic Text Mask Highlight And Glow Reveal
use_when: A CapCut-style highlight wipe, split-mask gradient, or glow sweep needs to be reproduced outside CapCut.
The text is short, large, and important enough to justify a layered reveal.
The agent can control the background, safe region, and text layer alignment.
The effect needs true alpha so glow, blur, or antialiased text edges survive a later composite.
avoid_when: The line is dense continuous caption text.
The base typography, contrast, and phrase break are not already readable.
The background is too bright or busy for a glow/highlight pass to preserve crisp edges.
The implementation would hide faces, proof, UI, products, or key action.

timeline_pattern.pattern: base_video -> base_text -> duplicate_styled_text -> optional_highlight_or_glow_layer -> animated_reveal_mask -> composite -> phone_size_qc
timeline_pattern.alignment_rule: Base text, styled duplicate text, and any glow duplicate must share font, size, tracking, line breaks, and position.
timeline_pattern.mask_rule: Start the mask fully off the word, move it across the intended text span, and end it fully off the word.
timeline_pattern.glow_rule: Reveal the glow duplicate with the same mask timing as the sharp text so there is no pre-glow or lingering tail glow.
timeline_pattern.alpha_rule: If the effect is exported for later compositing, use a true transparent overlay rather than chroma key or an opaque black background.

motion.rule: Use exact timed progress for masks and only add spring or bounce to the whole word group if readability survives.

keyframe_values.remotion_progress: Use a clamped 0-to-1 progress value over the reveal window; begin after the word is established and finish before the next reading task.
keyframe_values.mask_bounds: Pad the mask travel beyond the text bounds so the first and last visible frames have no sliver.
keyframe_values.ffmpeg_test_window: Render a short 1-2 second test before applying the effect across a full edit.

sound.rule: Use no sound or one soft shimmer/tick that starts with the visible reveal and ends with the mask pass; keep it below speech.

captions.rule: Suppress or reposition ordinary captions if the styled text already carries the spoken phrase or occupies the caption region.

color.rule: Both the base state and highlighted/glowing state must preserve readable letter edges; compare against a plain text fallback.

implementation.ffmpeg: Use drawtext or pre-rendered text for the foreground, attach a grayscale reveal mask with alphamerge, then overlay over the background or export as ProRes 4444/PNG sequence if the result remains reusable; generate contact sheets around mask start, midpoint, final hold, and clear.
implementation.remotion: Build layered text with a base layer and absolute duplicate layer; animate CSS mask-image, SVG mask, clip-path, or mask position from off-word to off-word; optionally add a separately masked blurred duplicate for glow, then export transparent ProRes 4444 when compositing outside Remotion.
implementation.blender: Use duplicate text objects or compositor text renders, reveal the styled duplicate with an animated mask, and limit bloom so edges remain readable.
implementation.capcut_equivalent: Duplicate text, compound the duplicate or highlight group, apply Split or Film Strip mask, keyframe the mask across the word, tune feather/glow, and confirm start/end off-word.
implementation.premiere_equivalent: Duplicate Essential Graphics text, nest the styled version, animate a track matte/linear wipe/mask across it, and add a restrained glow only after a clean matte pass.

common_mistakes: Trying to create a true glow sweep with raw drawtext only instead of a masked overlay pass.
Misaligning duplicate text layers so letters jump during the reveal.
Letting the glow appear before the sweep reaches the word.
Using a highlight color that lowers contrast during the wipe.
Applying the effect to long subtitles or small text.
Exporting a reusable glow/mask overlay to MP4 and losing alpha.
Using overlay alone in FFmpeg while expecting it to create the reveal mask.
qc: Base and duplicate text layers align exactly at the reveal midpoint.
Mask starts and ends fully off-word with no sliver, pre-glow, or tail glow.
Styled and plain text states are readable at phone size.
Captions, faces, proof, UI, products, and action remain safe.
Any shimmer/tick cue ends with the visual reveal and stays below speech.
Reusable overlay export has a verified alpha channel and no black rectangle.
Mask polarity is correct: white reveals, black hides.
